measure.composite: Every resolved color rounds per channel to 8 bits, half up. A translucent layer or ink composites source-over in sRGB and the result rounds per channel to 8 bits. The ratio is taken on those rounded values.
measure.alpha: A cell passes with the alpha as given by the token and with the alpha itself rounded to n/255.
measure.grades: 4.5 text, 3 non-text, null no target. The ratio is compared before display rounding.
measure.boundary: A cell within 0.05 above its grade is listed by design. One 8-bit step moves a ratio by about 0.02 to 0.04.
